files.name: StoneByHand.java

help: Mine visible stone within reach (or dig a few blocks straight down) after collect stone timed out
lesson: collect TIMEOUT is mostly collect:stone. Its stair-down or shore sub-step can loop until the 240 s limit, so a retry needs a different method: plain mining of stone in sight, done by hand.
summary: stone_by_hand: after collect:stone TIMEOUT, mines stone in reach by hand, or digs up to 6 blocks straight down to reach it, instead of rerunning the stair or shore loop that timed out.
